facts.text: Deerwood earned its name from the abundant wildlife—turkeys, wild hogs, raccoons, bears, and many deer that once roamed the area.
Don Davis became Deerwood Country Club’s general manager in 1965, steering the club for more than two decades.
The Collins Group mapped 26 one‑acre homesites on Collins Grove Road while setting aside 100 acres for conservation.
Deerwood was Florida’s first gated community, a pioneering model for private residential security.
The Deerwood golf course hosted the Greater Jacksonville Open in the late 1960s and early 1970s, and once hosted talks between President Gerald Ford and Egyptian President Anwar Sadat in 1975.
Richard Green Skinner’s heirs divided his 40,000‑acre estate, giving his children the land that would become Deerwood.
